sloka: यां वृत्तिं वर्त्तते तातो यां च न: प्रपितामहा: ।तां वृत्तिं वर्त्तसे कच्चिद्या च सत्पथगा शुभा ॥ २.१००.७५॥
transliteration: yāṁ vṛttiṁ varttate tāto yāṁ ca na: prapitāmahā: ।tāṁ vṛttiṁ varttase kaccidyā ca satpathagā śubhā ॥ 2.100.75॥

translations.english: O Bharata, I trust you do not partake delicious food all by yourself, and you share it with your friends when they want it.
